Firehouse chilli bites.d: Ground beef and kidney beans simmered with hot chili powder, spooned into baked wonton shells, sharp cheddar melted over in the oven.

Miracle Mets pretzels with beer mustard.d: Dipped in a baking soda bath, baked glossy brown under coarse salt. Warm, with a whole-grain beer mustard sweetened with honey.

Queens pizza.d: Thin and crisp, crushed tomato, mozzarella and crumbled Italian sausage, baked hot on the steel.
Queens pizza.note: By the slice or the whole pie, boxed to take home.

Julia's apple pie.d: Granny Smiths with cinnamon and sugar under a double crust, brushed with egg and baked golden.
Julia's apple pie.note: Baked at home and carried down to the firehouse.

Firehouse lemon shandy.d: Cold lager topped with fresh-squeezed lemonade, a sprig of mint and a citrus wheel. Grown-ups only.
